question: How many orders were placed in each year?
sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY order_year;

question: Which 10 products generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT TOP (10) p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.list_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM sales.order_items oi JOIN production.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
